name: dev_invoke_codex-cli
description: Claude-native adapter for invoking OpenAI Codex CLI through markdown handoff files. Use when Claude Code needs an explicit Codex QAQC review, Codex code review, cross-harness verification, implementation pass, refactoring pass, or second-model opinion. Default to read-only review unless the user explicitly asks Codex to edit files. Uses current `codex exec` commands, repository-local paths, and TASK.md/OUTPUT.md artifacts under `agent_tasks/handoffs/codex/`.
